runtime.execution: Asyncio per-session admission/queues, immutable admitted provider runtime, shared hook/tool runner and managed process sessions.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local session/memory/child/task state and process lifetimes; consumes providers/MCP/channel services, not a shared compute governor.

summary: A multi-channel agent with checkpointed interruption/recovery, programmable host hooks and bounded model runtime self-control.

inspection.scope: Read entry/runner actual provider/tool/checkpoint flow, runtime control, process/session persistence, compaction, subagents, tools, channel reload and stop/reload tests.
inspection.limits: No source executed. Dream implementation, all channel/provider adapters and deployment restart orchestration not exhaustively traced; no universal absence claims.

actions.name: Filesystem / search / apply_patch discovery
actions.lifecycle: tool classes scoped by loader; per-request read state

actions.name: exec sessions / stdin / poll / terminate
actions.input: command, cwd, timeout, existing session handle/characters
actions.lifecycle: owned ongoing process across actions; deadlines checked on poll; owner-scoped cleanup
actions.authority: model tool; process-tree option and host policy

actions.name: my runtime inspection/changes
actions.input: allowlisted snapshot key/set value or model_preset
actions.lifecycle: admitted request runtime immutable; modification default disabled
actions.authority: model with allow_set; core machinery deliberately blocked

actions.name: spawn and child result routing
actions.input: task, label, session origin, admitted runtime
actions.lifecycle: semaphore admitted independent run; result injects before next request
actions.authority: model/host child tools limited by scope

actions.name: Compact / stop / checkpoint recovery
actions.output: summary boundary or completed partial context
actions.lifecycle: explicit stop differs from shutdown; compaction captures append boundary

actions.name: search_sessions/read_session
actions.lifecycle: persisted session retrieval; current active session excluded

actions.name: Host hooks and tool plugins/channel enable-disable
actions.input: Python hooks/entry-point classes or feature action
actions.output: modified requests/tool results; live channel clients
actions.lifecycle: loop hook phases, cached discovery and channel-specific reload
actions.authority: host programmer; model runtime control does not replace hooks

filesystem.detail: Scoped read/write/search/patch class discovery; actual write replaces text; request-local state.

processes.detail: Ongoing owned piped program sessions, stdin/poll/terminate; decoded/truncated streams and kill timeout limits.

code_actions.detail: Commands can compose programs through shell; Python host hooks/plugins are executable. No traced persistent model-authored kernel API.

persistent_kernel.detail: Ongoing process sessions can run interpreters but no specific shared persistent namespace/checkpoint contract traced.

standing_database.detail: Owned structured sessions/cursors and Markdown/JSONL memories; model session snippets are narrow, no general standing SQL research table interface in inspected paths.

workflow_programming.detail: AgentRunSpec injection/continuation/checkpoint callbacks and hook phases are programmable host machinery, plus scoped tool plugins.

multi_model.detail: Immutable per-admission provider runtime, default/session presets and independently captured child runtime; no selection-to-collaboration inference.

live_collaboration.detail: Child completion bus into busy-parent next-request snapshots; peer-addressed ongoing room not established.

concurrent_work.detail: Independent child semaphore/task tracking and safe tool batch dispatch; multiple owned exec sessions across actions.

steering_interrupt.detail: Queued injections before each provider request and explicit stop preserves partial results. Kill attempts bounded with suppressed failure/timeout, not guaranteed globally settled work.

turn_redefinition.detail: Host hook/injection/continuation phases alter running loop; MyTool cannot replace core runner/hooks.

compaction.detail: Managed summary replay boundary retains raw message transcript, captures concurrent append boundary and emits phase outcomes; old provider state cleared.

context_repair.detail: Retained prefix and checkpoint restore support host reconstruction; model read_session visible excerpts exclude active session and tool stream.

original_audit.detail: Retained transcript is already normalized result data; bounded decoded process IO loses originals. Atomic replacement default not fsynced; not captured all original provider/program attempts.

audit_query.detail: Model persisted visible user/assistant session retrieval is bounded and excludes active session; full original captured IO not available.

hot_change.detail: Future-turn config/model admissions and live channel start/stop; cached tool discovery not unrestricted live replacement.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Shutdown retains recovery checkpoint and persisted session; no outpost/native executable replacement or preservation of owned active process handles traced.

remote_services.detail: Tool loader admits MCP/channel services and hot channel clients; lower remote work settlement and shared-service orchestration outside inspected core.

self_improvement.detail: Memory Git/Dream groundwork inspected, but candidate executable-policy change/evaluate/promote machinery not traced; generic edits insufficient.

complaints.detail: Inspected native tool/core paths do not establish universal model state-capturing grievance and separate complaint table.

authority.detail: Filesystem/workspace and scoped tool authority; model self-control enabled inspection but mutation false by default, core runner/hooks blocked.

evaluation.detail: Read literal stop checkpoint and event-gated channel start/stop oracles; mocks cannot establish actual provider/program settlement or crash persistence.

time_order.detail: Owned exec deadlines/elapsed use monotonic; idle archival uses civil timestamps and compaction identity/boundary, no paused cross-process clock contract.

evidence.claim: Actual loop runs shared agent engine and records messages/provider compaction/checkpoints and continuation.
Finite inbox snapshot before model request, hooks, assistant checkpoint then batched tool execution and normalized results.
Config invalidation and default/session model choices apply to immutable future-turn admissions.
MyTool enabled but modification default false, narrow adapter blocks core runner/session/hook/authority replacement.
Session model preset selected for next turn; direct instance-wide model/window changes refused during active session.
Cached built-in package/entry-point tool discovery, scoped create/enabled checks and native name precedence.
Native FS tool class permissions separate read/write allowed paths with request-scoped file state.
Native write_file resolves write path then replaces file text and clears read state.
Owned process sessions use monotonic start/deadline, separate bounded decoded streams; UTF-8 errors replaced.
Polling yields output, timeout kills, checks exit, drains output with limits; kill waits on stream tasks with suppressed timeout.
Root/process-group or Windows job-tree kill and bounded awaited root exit; suppressed timeout/errors limit guaranteed settlement.
Owner-scoped termination reinserts sessions on kill exceptions, avoiding loss of failed handle custody.
Explicit stop restores runtime checkpoint completed results; gateway shutdown keeps durable checkpoint untouched.
Summary checkpoint changes replay boundary while retaining message transcript, legal tool-result start.
Compaction serializes captured boundary, preserves concurrent appends, clears provider replay state, emits phase outcomes.
Idle archival skips active keys and emits failure handling; TTL uses civil wall time.
Session JSONL full-state atomic replacement, optional fsync default false and checkpoint overlay removed after save.
Model reads bounded visible user/assistant sessions with snippets, excludes active session key; no raw tool/provider stream query.
Each child captures explicit runtime; semaphore and task maps plus isolated owned exec manager.
Child completion routed to parent pending injection queue via system bus rather than competing session task.
Standing memory is Markdown/JSONL with cursor and Git tracking, not an exposed SQL research store.
Hot channel actions reload config and start/stop owned channel clients; always-enabled feature requires restart.
Injected cancellation oracle checks exact roles/tool result recovery, checkpoint cleared and save invoked; fake IO does not establish actual crash durability.
Gated fake channel start/stop oracle asserts no restart required and channel removed/stopped.

tests.oracle: Exact user/assistant/tool sequence and checkpoint clearing/save invoked; mocked persistence/provider, no crash durability proof.
Wait for start event, exact stopped/removal/no restart; fake channel, not all adapter replacement.

strengths: Explicit stop/shutdown recovery distinction with direct checkpoint-content oracle.
Immutable admitted provider runtime separates active from future-turn changes.
Failed owner cleanup reinserts handle custody rather than forgetting work.
limits: MyTool mutation opt-in/allowlisted; core hooks/runtime not model-replaceable through it.
Selective bounded transformed transcripts and IO cannot serve comprehensive audit.
Native refit/outpost and peer room not established.
arconaut_questions: Specify checkpoint treatment for explicit interrupt, failed workflow and replacement shutdown separately.
Make refit require observed settlement rather than a sent kill/cancel signal.
Preserve model program agency while staging definition changes after affected workflows conclude.
